detail.longDescription: Installed Google’s Modern Web Guidance skills out of curiosity— —only to see that Google would default to tracking its use. I know, telemetry, but this can mean anything, and there’s no trust. US companies do not read the room. If you run into the same situation, `npx skills remove modern-web-guidance find-skills -g` seems to uninstall properly (comment if I miss something). # google # webdev # webguidance
